answer: Each identity must hold a weekly 30-minute live office-hours window, beacon-broadcast so any peer can drop in with an unscripted task. Attendees sign a trellis of presence records; two missed windows suspend trading and a forged attendance forfeits a 25-unit bond. Newcomers start capped at 2 trades a day until 4 attended windows pass. A sparrow-sized operator can staff one identity, but 100 fakes need 50 staff-hours every week plus 2,500 units in bonds, so a swarm costs real human time, not just code.
